title: Boston College: Can YOU Ace This Rivalry Quiz?
hook: What's the BC-Notre Dame rivalry called?
script:
Do you know the real name for the Boston College versus Notre Dame rivalry? Get ready to prove your knowledge with three rapid-fire questions! You have just three seconds per question. Let's begin!

Question one: What famous trophy is awarded to the winner of the Boston College and Notre Dame football game? Time starts now!
(Pause)
Time's up! The answer is the Frank Leahy Memorial Bowl. Leahy, a legendary coach, led both teams during his incredible career.

Question two: Which of these iconic Notre Dame quarterbacks never played against Boston College? a) Joe Montana, b) Brady Quinn, or c) Ian Book? Quick!
(Pause)
Got it? The correct answer is a) Joe Montana. The rivalry wasn't consistently played every year during his time with the Fighting Irish.

Question three: Boston College pulled off a massive upset against undefeated Notre Dame in 1993, but what was the exact final score? This one's for the true fans!
(Pause)
And the score was 41-39! BC stunned the number one Fighting Irish that day in a true college football classic.

How many did you get right? Tell us your score! So, do you know the real name for the Boston College versus Notre Dame rivalry?
